name: How does BIM improve coordination between architects and contractors?

mainEntity.name: How does BIM improve coordination between architects and contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: BIM provides a shared, real-time 3D model with embedded data, allowing all team members to visualize clashes, track changes, and access schedules/materials info, reducing field errors and RFIs. autodesk​
